meta.title: Logistics & distribution
meta.summary: Things don’t get where they’re going by wishing very hard. Roads, rail, air, water, planning, and people keep Ohio’s farms, factories, shops, and customers connected.

blocks.text: Ohio’s location and transport connections support a substantial logistics network. Warehouses and distribution centers are the visible landmarks, while data, equipment, scheduling, and skilled workers organize what moves between them. A shipment might use more than one mode before it reaches its destination—a relay of visible routes and quiet coordination.

These links matter to other industries too: a farm, factory, hospital, or shop depends on supplies arriving when needed. JobsOhio describes the transport network and approaches to freight and distribution. Look beyond the warehouses and you’ll see how freight connections help make everyday life possible. I’d follow the moment one team hands the delivery to the next. That little transfer can hide a surprising amount of coordination.
